context: A rubber-stamp reason refused at approval

checklist.name: explains_refusal
checklist.description: Explains that a reason made only of filler such as LGTM is refused (exit 2, usage) because the audit log keeps the reason and it must say what was checked.

checklist.name: real_reason
checklist.description: The new `wayglass approve iccccccccc1 --reason ...` names what was checked: the tests that ran and passed, and that the change stays inside docs/**.

checklist.name: family_declared
checklist.description: Declares its own family as openai (WAYGLASS_AGENT_FAMILY=openai or `--family openai`).

checklist.name: json_flag
checklist.description: Passes `--json` and branches on the exit code or `data.decision.status`.
